confirmed_common_cause.root_cause: Renderer only draws EntityKind values that have a MobEntry: entity_renderer.rs render loop calls self.mobs.get(&info.entity_kind), then continue on None. mob_definitions() contains a finite explicit list; target kinds with no definition have no baked model/texture and are silently skipped. Network spawn/metadata receipt therefore does not imply render support.
code_evidence: pomme-client/src/renderer/pipelines/entity_renderer.rs:~700 onward (explicit MobDef model/texture registration; no boat, allay, armadillo, etc. entries for most absent targets)
pomme-client/src/net/handler.rs:1161 onward (AddEntity converted into EntitySpawned event)
pomme-client/src/net/handler.rs:1493 onward (scalar synced metadata forwarded to EntityData)
confirmed_common_cause.smallest_fix_direction: Implement/render the missing entity kinds with their appropriate model and texture, routing special renderer families (boats/minecarts/projectiles/displays/block entities) through suitable existing or dedicated render paths. Do not patch metadata as a general remedy: for an absent MobEntry, even correctly received metadata is never rendered.
confirmed_common_cause.evidence_status: Source confirms the skip mechanism and missing explicit registrations. No source edits or runtime retest performed; not marked fixed.

metadata_and_variants.finding: Received AddEntity carries EntityKind and transforms into a spawn event. SetEntityData scalar values are forwarded to EntityStore::apply_entity_data, which interprets by kind/index and normalizes version-sensitive ageable/player indices. Renderer receives already assembled EntityRenderInfo including variant_index, overlays, and pose fields. Existing support is model-specific, not a universal entity renderer.
metadata_and_variants.candidate_handling: Bogged and zombie_villager have registered base rendering paths. Bogged head mushrooms and zombie-villager hat/profession clothing remain unconfirmed candidates; candidate observations themselves do not confirm material/variant metadata bugs.
